_comment: What the plugin's bootstrap is allowed to fetch, and nothing else. The version is
not repeated here: it is read from .codex-plugin/plugin.json, so the plugin can only
ever fetch the release that matches itself.
`sha256` maps a version to the digest of its published archive. A version listed here
is verified against that digest and the published .sha256 sidecar is not consulted at
all. A version that is absent, or null, falls back to the sidecar - which is weaker,
and the bootstrap says so out loud rather than implying a guarantee it does not have.
The entry is null at the moment a version is tagged and filled in afterwards, because
the digest cannot be known before the archive exists. The archive is not reproducible
either - the in-box C# compiler stamps a fresh module version GUID into every build -
so the digest has to come from the published file rather than from a local rebuild.
CONTRIBUTING.md carries that as a release step.
